newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Sept bond future rises to key 103.50 level.
newsitem.headline: Spain Sept bond future rises to key 103.50 level.

text.p: Spain's 10-year September bond future rose to a key pyschological level of 103.50 in late trade, boosted by better than expected August inflation data both at home and in the U.S., dealers said.
The September contract closed yesterday at 102.52.

Spanish bonds were able to increase gains this afternoon after U.S. inflation and retail sales data were also below forecasts, driving Treasuries higher on diminished fears of an imminent hike in key rates, they added.
The bond future briefly touched a new historic high of 103.52. -- Madrid newsroom +341 585 2160
